description.value: Boer Mountain Coffee House is a café on the Yellowhead Highway in BC's Central Interior, a major cycling corridor through the Cariboo and Bulkley regions. Located at a ground-level highway address, it offers sit-down and takeout service with a no-smoking policy. For touring cyclists passing through this remote stretch, it represents a rare opportunity for a hot drink and a rest stop.
